request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply: Government reporting shows a **3% (about $480 million) year-over-year increase in Ford-class program unit costs**, but this is not a first-of-class CVN-78-only overrun figure. CRS reports CVN-78’s final procurement cost as **$13,316.5 million** in then-year dollars; the reviewed evidence does not provide the original baseline needed to calculate its overrun (CRS RS20643, PDF pp. 7, 19). The brief also explains the cost-growth caveat and findings for other programs: output/briefs/case-20261025-175515-8339.html
reply.reasoning: Verified sources provide a useful Ford-class annual cost-growth figure and the lead ship’s final procurement cost, but not a baseline-to-final first-of-class overrun calculation.
